seeds.title: branchName passes the tail as a String.replace replacement string
seeds.detail: A tail with $&, $$, $', $` or a$&b is rewritten by String.replace. The spec text shows this exact code. Real tails hold ids, rounds, profile names and parts, so none holds a dollar sign. A function replacement or split/join would make it exact.

seeds.title: A format with both {name} and {name:lower} leaves {name} unreplaced
seeds.detail: branchName('AB') with a-{name}-{name:lower} gives a-{name}-ab. The spec does not define this format. Check that format validation rejects it.
